notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076914/ddd6419ea57b480162c6a4b9d925ab327d3ddec6.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello Pyron warriors, Here are the bug fixes and updates for the VER.0.5.3.0 demo build.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Added the missing incapacitate motion of [spoiler]Guardian of Teradin [/spoiler][/p][p]Fixed an issue where the screen continued to display after clearing [spoiler]Guardian of Teradin[/spoiler] and moving to the next area[/p][p]Fixed an issue where the blue diamond indicator for newly acquired items did not disappear in the inventory[/p][p]Fixed an issue with [spoiler]Teradin Gatekeeper[/spoiler]: after lever interaction was forcibly canceled due to being hit, sometimes the lever could not be opened[/p][p]Fixed an issue where npc [spoiler]Lunya[/spoiler] could be invited to the library[/p][p]Fixed an issue where input prompts remained displayed in some tutorials[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Updates[/h2][list][*][p]Lowered the difficulty of the early part of the Silent Ruins region[/p][p]Reduced grab damage of the boss [spoiler]Fidiel[/spoiler][/p][p]Reduced creature homing performance: The original performance was too strong and caused discomfort for many players, so it has been toned down.[/p][p]Adjusted some creature motions so that attack motions are more visible[/p][p]Changed shockwave pattern of mid-boss [spoiler]Moomoo[/spoiler][/p][p]Applied some missing scripts[/p][p]Corrected some mistranslations[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]We will continue to improve the game through player feedback.
Please feel free to share your thoughts anytime via Discord or Steam discussions![/p][p]
[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]From Studio Doodal[/p]

notes.title: Solateria Dev Log #01
notes.content:
Hello Pyron Warriors,

Since we began developing Solateria in January last year, this is our first time greeting you through a development log.
From now on, we plan to share monthly updates so that you can follow the game’s progress and improvements with us.

After showcasing our early build at various exhibitions, we’ve made major improvements:
We added clear rewards for parrying and restructured the gameplay to better support parry-focused combat.
We also introduced the Heat System to further reflect the identity of the flame warrior.

Additionally, we refined the creature designs, rebalanced background tones, and created new cutscenes.
Your feedback—both online and offline—made these changes possible, and we thank you for it.

This current build is vastly different from the one shown before.
We hope to share it with you soon. Now, let’s begin the April development log.


[h1][Solateria – Development Log #01][/h1]

[h2]1. New Cutscenes[/h2]
We focused on a variety of cinematic scenes this month—
From narrative moments with NPCs in beautiful landscapes, to dramatic boss deaths and wave finales.
We’ll first reveal a new cutscene from the Ashen Library, a safe haven for warriors who survived the Shadow Plague.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076914/9647a363f73cef8038132e12c9cd811bb5d2a1d7.gif[/img]

[h2]2. Parts System[/h2]
We’ve added a parts system to let you tailor your build:
Attack, Defense, Heat, and Wormhorn parts each offer unique enhancements, such as bonus damage under low health or persistent effects.
Equip one part of each type to customize your combat experience and explore more playstyles.

[h2]3. Heat System[/h2]
To highlight the Pyron identity, we added the Heat System, which allows warriors to channel their inner fire.
Unlockable in five tiers, this system enables special abilities in combat depending on your current heat level—
And at full charge, you’ll gain access to a powerful finisher.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076914/5fd3e85f3f94c137476ead0cffd7030f28f5a458.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076914/4972c21e62c8f1ae338be5c1e9254a1478314074.gif[/img]

That’s it for April’s development log.
Thank you always for playing Solateria, and we’ll see you again in next month’s update.
- Studio Doodal
